thread.title: Stock Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for February, 2nd (AAPL, AMZN, AON, CY, DATA, EW, GOOG, GTIM, IQE, LGND)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Stock Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for February, 2nd (AAPL, AMZN, AON, CY, DATA, EW, GOOG, GTIM, IQE, LGND)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Feb 2nd, 2018 // No Comments 
Stock Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Friday, February 2nd: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Maxim Group. The firm currently has a $210.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Normalized iPhone revenue sell-out up ~17% y/y; our ASP analysis suggests iPhone X represented 20% of the December quarter iPhone mix. Guidance embeds iPhone unit & revenue sell-out accelerates, even on a normalized basis. Bottom line power of iPhone X still not evident, but we continue to also model erosion of the iPhone X price premium in FY19, leading us to continue to utilize normalized valuation. Continue to utilize a normalized earnings framework, though increasing 12- month price target to $210, from $204, due to a lower tax rate than we had assumed new tax law would enable.”” Get Apple Inc alerts: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its positive rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $200.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $190.00. Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its overweight rating reiterated by analysts at Barclays PLC. 
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. 
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at UBS Group AG. 
Aon plc Class A (NYSE:AON) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co. They currently have a $143.00 target price on the stock. 
Cypress Semiconductor (NASDAQ:CY) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Needham & Company LLC. The analysts wrote, “Finishing a stellar 2017 (executing on key IoT , Auto, and USB-C markets, GM expanded 320 bps, FCF doubled to $349M, EPS grew 4x rev. to $0.89, leverage ratio declined to 2.3x) Cypress is on track for another year of significant earnings growth. We estimate that on modest 7% revenue growth driven by Wi-FI/ Bluetooth combo and mesh technologies in IoT , the adoption of USB-C, Auto content gains, and cross selling (as well as strong memory pricing, 70% of contracts locked in) Cypress can achieve 40% non-GAAP growth or $1.20 in 2018 – there is significant leverage in the model. Reiterate Buy.”” 
Tableau Software (NYSE:DATA) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. BMO Capital Markets currently has a $92.00 target price on the stock. 
Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE:EW) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. They currently have a $174.00 price target on the stock, up from their previous price target of $140.00. 
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. 
Good Times Restaurants (NASDAQ:GTIM) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Maxim Group. Maxim Group currently has a $6.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We maintain our Buy rating and $6 price target on Good Times Restaurants (GTIM) following the release of full F1Q18 (December) results yesterday.”” 
IQE (LON:IQE) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Peel Hunt. The firm currently has a GBX 188 ($2.64) target price on the stock. 
Ligand Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:LGND) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The firm currently has a $170.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Kyprolis Beats; Recent and Anticipated Label Expansions Represent Revenue Inflection Points Kyprolis quickly approaching blockbuster status. Yesterday, partner Amgen (AMGN; not rated) announced 4Q17 and 2017 Kyprolis revenue of $227M and $835M, respectively, compared with our estimates of $220M (consensus $225M) and $828M. As Kyprolis approaches blockbuster status, considering certain factors we think should be able to easily push it over the edge, and they include: 1) recent FDA approval of sNDA based on ENDEAVOR overall survival data; 2) recent CHMP positive opinion to include updated overall survival from ENDEAVOR on label this year in the E.U.; and 3) recent submission of sNDA to FDA and a variation to the marketing authorization to the EMA, both based on the overall survival benefit from the ASPIRE study (actions expected this year). Upcoming milestones and key programs underway: 2018 initial visibility from recent launch of Baxdela for serious skin infections.”” 
McKesson (NYSE:MCK) had its sell rating reaffirmed by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a $130.00 price target on the stock. 
Mplx (NYSE:MPLX) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. They currently have a $43.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $44.00. 
Msci (NYSE:MSCI) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a $150.00 price target on the stock. 
Provident Financial (LON:PFG) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Peel Hunt. They currently have a GBX 870 ($12.22) price target on the stock. 
Rigel Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RIGL) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The firm currently has a $7.00 price target on the stock. 
Roche (VTX:ROG) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. 
Shell Midstream Partners (NYSE:SHLX) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a $36.00 price target on the stock. 
Solar Capital (NASDAQ:SLRC) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at National Securities. The firm currently has a $25.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “• Solar pre-announced preliminary 4Q17 results and posted an estimated NII/share of $0.44 and NAV/share between $21.79 – $21.82. This compares with our previous 4Q17 NII/share estimate of $0.42 and our 12/31/17 NAV/share estimate of $21.75.• We expect Solar to be able to steadily grow its portfolio through 2018 without the need to issue equity, which should bolster NII and ROE. With traditional middle market cash flow lending, asset-based lending (ABL) through Crystal Financial, NEF (National Equipment finance), and life sciences lending, SLRC has a diversified revenue stream with verticals largely uncorrelated to each other. This leads us to expect the company to generate respectable portfolio growth even during challenging loan markets like the current one.• As we have previously stated, SLRC has been one of the most disciplined BDCs in terms of withholding originations during times of tighter credit spreads, in our opinion. If we examine the period of widening credit spreads from 2Q15 – 2Q16, SLRC originated a total of $677.6 million of investments. When spreads tightened (and they continue to) from 3Q16 – 3Q17, SLRC originated a total of $559.3 million of investments. We note that the 3Q17 number is skewed higher by the purchase of NEF for $210 million. Backing out this purchase, the originations during the spread tightening were only $349.3 million, or roughly 52% of volume during a much more favorable market.• We are increasing our 2017 NII/share estimate from $1.60 to $1.62 and are revising our 2018 NII/share estimate from $1.88 to $1.91. “ 
St. Modwen Properties (LON:SMP) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Peel Hunt. The firm currently has a GBX 425 ($5.97) target price on the stock. 
Stemline Therapeutics (NASDAQ:STML) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. HC Wainwright currently has a $38.00 price target on the stock. 
Triumph Group (NYSE:TGI) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. They currently have a $37.00 price target on the stock. 
Wabash National (NYSE:WNC) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. 
Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a $89.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $92.00.
